# Quant Buffet

> Bilingual (EN/zh) library of academic quantitative trading strategies with backtests, economic rationale, and QuantConnect/LEAN Python implementations.

## Site
- Home: https://www.quantbuffet.com/en
- Strategy library: https://www.quantbuffet.com/en/strategy-library
- Pricing: https://www.quantbuffet.com/en/pricing
- Contact: https://www.quantbuffet.com/en/contact
- Chinese home: https://www.quantbuffet.com/zh
- Sitemap: https://www.quantbuffet.com/sitemap.xml

## Audience
Systematic investors, quant researchers, prop traders, and developers studying algorithmic trading ideas grounded in academic papers.

## Topics
Momentum, mean reversion, pairs trading / statistical arbitrage, currency carry, factor investing (value, low volatility), seasonality, cross-asset trend following across equities, FX, futures, ETFs, CFDs, and related instruments.
